{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or 0.50) as it signals downward pressure.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods of negative sentiment; model tends to overreact.",
    "When true price drops sharply after a peak, reduce forecasted peak height by 10–15% to avoid overshoot.",
    "In the 10–15 day horizon, model tends to overestimate prices; apply a 5–10% downward bias.",
    "If sentiment turns positive (e.g., 0.50) after a downtrend, increase forecast slightly to reflect mean reversion.",
    "Avoid overfitting to recent highs; if last 3–5 days show strong upward momentum, cap forecast growth at 5% max.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, apply a 3–5% downward adjustment if true price has been below 60–65 for 5+ days."
  ]
}
